profile.headline: Software Engineer at Waymo
profile.summary: Robotics Software Engineer skilled in architecting and developing software systems for autonomous robots and communicating technical concepts. Strong experience in developing practical robotic systems in the autonomous vehicle industry and academia. Motivated to learn and become a leader in the robotics industry.

projects.title: MoonRanger
projects.description: MoonRanger is an ambitious project led primarily by students at CMU. The goal of the project is to design and build an autonomous micro-rover to search for water/ice on the south pole of the moon. I joined MoonRanger as a team lead on the Fault Monitoring system for the autonomous micro-rover. In this role, I designed and implemented onboard fault monitoring and recovery behaviors to recover from faults when the rover is operating autonomously on the moon.
